description:
Now, ride the Engwe L20 2.0 electric cycle and enjoy the fun of outdoor riding!
How Does the Engwe L20 2.0 Electric Bike Bring You Fun in Riding?
1. High torque allows you to break through the limitations of flat ground
Engwe L20 2.0 is equipped with a 1125W (peak power) 75Nm hub motor, which makes it a powerful e bike. It can not only move forward smoothly on flat ground, but also has the ability to conquer slopes, so that your riding is no longer limited to flat ground.
2. Fat tires allow you to unlock more terrains
The 20*3.0-inch fat tire is one of the most noteworthy highlights of the Engwe L20 2.0. This fat tyre electric bike can better absorb vibrations, allowing you to pass through different terrains more smoothly, such as gravel roads, sand roads, snow, etc., giving you the opportunity to unlock more terrains and explore a more exciting world.
3. The body design brings you more convenience
This is not only a step through electric bike, but also aN electric folding bike. In other words, when in use, you can easily cross the body and start riding; when not in use or when you need to transport it, you can quickly fold the body and then place it in a small space, the trunk of a car or carry it on public transportation such as the subway, which brings great convenience to your travel, storage and transportation.
4. Advanced battery technology makes long-distance riding possible
The 52V 13Ah lithium battery makes the L20 2.0 a long range electric bike. In Throttle mode, it can travel about 28 miles (45km) per charge; in Pedal Assist mode, it can travel 84 miles or 135km on a single charge. Relatively speaking, this e cycle has a long range, which can well alleviate your mileage anxiety.
5. 5 pedal assist modes provide you with appropriate assistance
L20 2.0 has 5 pedal assist modes to choose from. You can choose the appropriate mode to ride according to your physical condition, riding distance, etc., and find fun in riding.
6. Thoughtful design makes the riding experience more comfortable
Full suspension (front fork and post suspension) system, adjustable seat and handlebars and other thoughtful designs can increase the riding comfort. You can get a good riding experience from start to finish.
7. The rear rack improves the cargo-carrying capacity of L20 2.0
Engwe L20 2.0 is equipped with a bike rack on back, and it can carry up to 120kg, that is, 264lbs (including the weight of the rider, etc.), which means that you can use it to transport some things or people, making it a very practical choice. If you choose to install an additional front basket, its transportation capacity can be further improved.
Combining power, versatility and practicality, Engwe L20 2.0 is a practical electric bicycle that can meet your different needs. Whether it is used for commuting or outdoor adventures, this electric bike can make your journey more efficient, comfortable and convenient!
